usedFor: buttondown holds your newsletter subscribers, and Calendly turns each one into a booking link with “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Creating a Subscriber” in buttondown, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Each new subscriber gets a booking link ready to send, so a call is one click away.

watchOut: “subscriber updated” in buttondown fires on every change, so it would create a fresh link each time.
